name: Seated Hip Adduction Machine
grip: Hands gripping side support handles beside seat.
description: Squeeze the thighs inward against padded machine levers while seated, isolating the adductor muscle group of the inner thighs.
setup: Select the desired weight stack setting and release the range-of-motion lever to open the swing arms to a comfortable wide stretch.
Sit with your back firmly against the backrest, knees bent at 90 degrees, and inner knees resting against the padded lever arms.
Grasp the side stability handles lightly.
instructions: Squeeze your thighs smoothly together against the lever pads until they touch or meet in the center.
Pause under complete muscular control at the peak adduction contraction.
Slowly open your legs back to the wide starting position, resisting the stack resistance across the full range.
Do not let the weight stack smash down between repetitions.
cues: Keep back flat against the backrest.
commonMistakes: Using momentum or bouncing out of the wide stretch position.
Lifting the pelvis or lower back off the seat to force the pads together.
Setting the starting width beyond safe hip mobility.
